name: update_memory
description: Update or correct an existing memory. Use this when you realize a stored fact is outdated, incorrect, or needs to be changed. Can search for the memory automatically if you provide a search query instead of a memory ID.

memory_id.description: The ID of the memory to update (optional if search_query is provided)

search_query.description: Search for the memory to update by keywords (used if memory_id not provided). Example: 'favorite food' or 'pizza'

category.description: Optional category to narrow search (preference, fact, contact, etc.)
